entries.surface: costs.py (harvester/parser/aggregator + MD/JSON), mcp_server.py (plate_costs tool + schema), cli.py (gh plate costs cmd), baseline_catalog.yml (accountant skill update), tests/test_costs.py, fragment
entries.summary: Implemented dedicated surfaces per Epic #265 ACs: harvest USAGE REPORT blocks from closed issues (live via GH search/comments, parse tokens/cost/duration), aggregate (total + per issue), emit JSON + wiki MD. MCP plate_costs + gh plate costs (with --epic-label filter). Integrates with accountant agent. Tests with mocks. Updated catalog skill to reference new tool. Dogfood ready.
entries.migration_impact: New `gh plate costs` and `plate_costs` MCP tool available for agents/leads to query usage without manual parsing. .agentic/COSTS.md remains the log; tools provide on-demand aggregates. No breaking for existing reports.
entries.agent_notes: Call plate_costs (MCP) or gh plate costs [--epic-label 'Epic: foo'] to get aggregates + MD for wiki. Use in accountant delegations for real data. Prefer live GH over static log for freshness. Update .agentic/COSTS.md via workflow as before.
